prompt:

A full-body photograph in the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult American woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, deep dark brown hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold small flared temple bell, a bronze hammer head, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver ship's anchor, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop with a heavy rough copper a miniature anvil hanging at its end, and a single mixed-metal anklet.
